canonical_term: Gordman Properties v. Hall County Board of Equalization
summary: Nebraska case authority for using county board proceedings to challenge actual value, uniformity, or both.
plain_language: A taxpayer can argue that a property is valued too high, unequally valued compared with similar property, or both.

relationships.note: Protest hearing may include actual value and equalization arguments.

source_refs.citation: Gordman Props. v. Hall Cty. Bd. of Equal., 1987 Neb. Supreme Court text via Justia.
